items.question: Trong câu "The paradox is that after decades of industry experience, project participants still do not share a common understanding of the word "requirement".", từ "paradox" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The paradox is that after decades of industry experience, project participants still do not share a common understanding of the word "requirement".", what does "paradox" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: paradox /ˈpær.ə.dɒks/ (danh từ): nghịch lý. "The paradox is that…" = điều nghịch lý là…; dùng khi một sự thật trái ngược với điều ta mong đợi.
items.explanationEn: paradox /ˈpær.ə.dɒks/ (noun): a seemingly contradictory fact. "The paradox is that…" introduces a fact that goes against what you would expect.

items.question: Trong câu "a requirement is "anything that drives design choices"", từ "drive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a requirement is "anything that drives design choices"", what does "drive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drive /draɪv/ (động từ): chi phối, thúc đẩy. "drive decisions/choices" = chi phối các quyết định; nghĩa khác quen thuộc là "lái xe".
items.explanationEn: drive /draɪv/ (verb): to strongly influence. "Drive decisions/choices" means to be the main force behind them; the other common sense is to operate a car.

items.question: Trong câu "a requirement is a property a product must have to provide value to a stakeholder", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a requirement is a property a product must have to provide value to a stakeholder", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thuộc tính, đặc tính. Trong kỹ thuật, "property" là đặc tính của hệ thống (vd. tốc độ, bảo mật); ngoài đời thường nghĩa là tài sản.
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (noun): a quality or characteristic. In engineering, a property is a characteristic of a system (e.g. speed, security); in everyday use it often means owned land or buildings.

items.question: Trong câu "a requirement is a property a product must have to provide value to a stakeholder", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a requirement is a property a product must have to provide value to a stakeholder", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "project stakeholders" = các bên liên quan của dự án: khách hàng, người dùng, dev, tester, nhà quản lý…
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a party with an interest. "Project stakeholders" include customers, users, developers, testers, managers and anyone else affected.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements are a specification of what should be implemented.", từ "specification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements are a specification of what should be implemented.", what does "specification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: specification /ˌspes.ɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): bản đặc tả chi tiết. Viết tắt quen thuộc: SRS = Software Requirements Specification (đặc tả yêu cầu phần mềm). Động từ: specify.
items.explanationEn: specification /ˌspes.ɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a detailed description. A familiar abbreviation is SRS, Software Requirements Specification. Related verb: specify.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements are a specification of what should be implemented.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements are a specification of what should be implemented.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): triển khai, hiện thực. "implement a feature/requirement" = viết code để hiện thực một tính năng/yêu cầu. Danh từ: implementation.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to put into effect. "Implement a feature/requirement" means to build it in code. Noun: implementation.

items.question: Trong câu "They are descriptions of how the system should behave, or of a system property or attribute.", từ "attribute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are descriptions of how the system should behave, or of a system property or attribute.", what does "attribute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attribute /ˈæt.rɪ.bjuːt/ (danh từ): thuộc tính, đặc điểm. "quality attribute" = thuộc tính chất lượng (hiệu năng, bảo mật, tính khả dụng…).
items.explanationEn: attribute /ˈæt.rɪ.bjuːt/ (noun): a quality or feature. "Quality attribute" covers characteristics such as performance, security and usability.

items.question: Trong câu "They may be a constraint on the development process of the system.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They may be a constraint on the development process of the system.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "a constraint on something" = một ràng buộc đối với cái gì; vd. ngân sách, công nghệ bắt buộc.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. "A constraint on something" limits it, for example a fixed budget or a mandated technology.

items.question: Trong câu "This definition matters because it acknowledges that "the requirements" are a collection of several different kinds of information: behaviour visible to the user, internal characteristics developers care about, and constraints.", từ "acknowledge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This definition matters because it acknowledges that "the requirements" are a collection of several different kinds of information: behaviour visible to the user, internal characteristics developers care about, and constraints.", what does "acknowledge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: acknowledge /əkˈnɒl.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "acknowledge that…" = thừa nhận rằng…; cũng dùng với nghĩa "xác nhận đã nhận" (acknowledge receipt).
items.explanationEn: acknowledge /əkˈnɒl.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to accept as true. "Acknowledge that…" means to admit or accept it; it can also mean to confirm receipt of something.

items.question: Trong câu "A requirement may describe the current system, a near-term need (high priority), a mid-term need (medium priority), or a hypothetical future need (low priority).", từ "hypothetical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A requirement may describe the current system, a near-term need (high priority), a mid-term need (medium priority), or a hypothetical future need (low priority).", what does "hypothetical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hypothetical /ˌhaɪ.pəˈθet.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giả định. "a hypothetical scenario/need" = một tình huống/nhu cầu giả định. Danh từ: hypothesis.
items.explanationEn: hypothetical /ˌhaɪ.pəˈθet.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): supposed, imagined. "A hypothetical scenario/need" is one that might happen but is not real yet. Noun: hypothesis.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not waste time debating whether something "is really a requirement" just because you know it will not be built in this release — it still is one; its turn simply has not come.", từ "debate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not waste time debating whether something "is really a requirement" just because you know it will not be built in this release — it still is one; its turn simply has not come.", what does "debate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: debate /dɪˈbeɪt/ (động từ): tranh luận. "debate whether…" = tranh luận xem liệu…; cũng là danh từ: a debate (cuộc tranh luận).
items.explanationEn: debate /dɪˈbeɪt/ (verb): to argue about. "Debate whether…" means to discuss opposing views on it; it is also a noun: a debate.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not assume all your project stakeholders share a common notion of what requirements are.", từ "notion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not assume all your project stakeholders share a common notion of what requirements are.", what does "notion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notion /ˈnəʊ.ʃən/ (danh từ): khái niệm, quan niệm. "a common notion of X" = cách hiểu chung về X. Gần nghĩa: concept, idea.
items.explanationEn: notion /ˈnəʊ.ʃən/ (noun): an idea or belief. "A common notion of X" is a shared idea of what X is. Similar: concept, idea.

items.question: Trong câu "Establish definitions up front so that you are all talking about the same things.", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Establish definitions up front so that you are all talking about the same things.", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "agree/pay up front" = thống nhất/trả tiền ngay từ đầu, trước khi bắt tay vào việc.
items.explanationEn: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): at the very beginning. "Agree/pay up front" means doing it at the start, before the work begins.

items.question: Trong câu "Software requirements come in three distinct levels.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software requirements come in three distinct levels.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): riêng biệt. "distinct from" = khác biệt với; danh từ "distinction" = sự phân biệt.
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): clearly separate. "Distinct from" means clearly different from; the noun is "distinction".

items.question: Trong câu "This model is the foundation of the whole course.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This model is the foundation of the whole course.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the base everything is built on
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): nền tảng. "the foundation of X" = nền tảng của X; nghĩa khác: quỹ, tổ chức (vd. Linux Foundation).
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the base everything is built on. "The foundation of X" is its base; another sense is an organization such as a charity.

items.question: Trong câu "Alignment across the three levels is essential for project success.", từ "alignment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Alignment across the three levels is essential for project success.", what does "alignment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the positioning of text on a page
items.explanation: alignment /əˈlaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự nhất quán, ăn khớp. "in alignment with" = ăn khớp, phù hợp với; động từ: align. Trong soạn thảo, alignment còn là căn lề.
items.explanationEn: alignment /əˈlaɪn.mənt/ (noun): agreement and consistency between parts. "In alignment with" means consistent with; verb: align. In text editing it also means the positioning of text.

items.question: Trong câu "If you cannot trace it back, ask why it exists.", từ "trace back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you cannot trace it back, ask why it exists.", what does "trace back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: trace back /ˌtreɪs ˈbæk/ (cụm từ): truy ngược nguồn gốc. "trace X back to Y" = truy X ngược về Y; danh từ liên quan: traceability (khả năng truy vết).
items.explanationEn: trace back /ˌtreɪs ˈbæk/ (phrase): to follow to its origin. "Trace X back to Y" means to find where X came from; related noun: traceability.

items.question: Trong câu "That objective leads to the idea of a self-service check-in kiosk.", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That objective leads to the idea of a self-service check-in kiosk.", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. "business objectives" = mục tiêu kinh doanh; khi là tính từ, "objective" nghĩa là khách quan.
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (noun): a goal to achieve. "Business objectives" are business goals; as an adjective, "objective" means unbiased.

items.question: Trong câu "Beyond the three levels you will meet several other categories", từ "category" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beyond the three levels you will meet several other categories", what does "category" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of tasks to do
items.explanation: category /ˈkæt.ə.ɡər.i/ (danh từ): nhóm, hạng mục. "fall into a category" = thuộc một nhóm; động từ: categorize (phân loại).
items.explanationEn: category /ˈkæt.ə.ɡər.i/ (noun): a group of similar things. "Fall into a category" means to belong to a group; verb: categorize.

items.question: Trong câu "A policy, guideline, standard, regulation, or computational algorithm of the business.", từ "policy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A policy, guideline, standard, regulation, or computational algorithm of the business.", what does "policy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (danh từ): chính sách, quy định. "company policy" = chính sách công ty; "insurance policy" là nghĩa khác: hợp đồng bảo hiểm.
items.explanationEn: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (noun): a set of official rules. "Company policy" is an official rule set; "insurance policy" is a different sense: an insurance contract.

items.question: Trong câu "A restriction imposed on the design and construction choices available to the developer.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A restriction imposed on the design and construction choices available to the developer.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt. "impose a limit/restriction on X" = áp đặt giới hạn lên X.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to force on someone. "Impose a limit/restriction on X" means to force that limit on X.

items.question: Trong câu "A property the system must exhibit, or a constraint it must respect.", từ "exhibit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A property the system must exhibit, or a constraint it must respect.", what does "exhibit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put on public display in a gallery
to show or display a quality
items.explanation: exhibit /ɪɡˈzɪb.ɪt/ (động từ): thể hiện, biểu lộ. "exhibit behaviour/a property" = thể hiện hành vi/đặc tính; nghĩa khác: trưng bày ở triển lãm.
items.explanationEn: exhibit /ɪɡˈzɪb.ɪt/ (verb): to show or display a quality. "Exhibit behaviour/a property" means to show it; another sense is to display items in an exhibition.

items.question: Trong câu "Because it exists independently of any application.", từ "independently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because it exists independently of any application.", what does "independently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách độc lập. "independently of X" = độc lập với X, không phụ thuộc vào X.
items.explanationEn: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (adverb): without relying on others. "Independently of X" means without depending on X.

items.question: Trong câu "The rule "employees must retake hazardous-chemical training every year" holds even if the company works entirely on paper.", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rule "employees must retake hazardous-chemical training every year" holds even if the company works entirely on paper.", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): vẫn còn đúng. "the rule holds" = quy tắc vẫn đúng; "hold" còn có nghĩa cầm nắm, tổ chức (hold a meeting).
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to remain true or valid. "The rule holds" means it stays valid; "hold" also means to grip, or to organize (hold a meeting).

items.question: Trong câu "is widely criticised because it says what these requirements are not, rather than what they are", từ "criticise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is widely criticised because it says what these requirements are not, rather than what they are", what does "criticise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: criticise /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.saɪz/ (động từ): chỉ trích, phê bình. "be widely criticised" = bị chỉ trích rộng rãi. Chính tả Mỹ: criticize.
items.explanationEn: criticise /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.saɪz/ (verb): to point out faults. "Be widely criticised" means many people find fault with it. US spelling: criticize.

items.question: Trong câu "You can deliver a product that has all the desired functionality and still have users hate it, because it does not match their (often unstated) quality expectations.", từ "deliver" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can deliver a product that has all the desired functionality and still have users hate it, because it does not match their (often unstated) quality expectations.", what does "deliver" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring goods to a home
items.explanation: deliver /dɪˈlɪv.ər/ (động từ): bàn giao, hoàn thành. "deliver a product/feature" = bàn giao sản phẩm/tính năng cho khách; danh từ: delivery.
items.explanationEn: deliver /dɪˈlɪv.ər/ (verb): to hand over finished work. "Deliver a product/feature" means to hand it over to the customer; noun: delivery.

items.question: Trong câu "You can deliver a product that has all the desired functionality and still have users hate it, because it does not match their (often unstated) quality expectations.", từ "unstated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can deliver a product that has all the desired functionality and still have users hate it, because it does not match their (often unstated) quality expectations.", what does "unstated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unstated /ʌnˈsteɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): không được nói ra. "unstated expectations/assumptions" = kỳ vọng/giả định ngầm, không nói ra. Trái nghĩa: explicit.
items.explanationEn: unstated /ʌnˈsteɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): not put into words. "Unstated expectations/assumptions" are implied but never said. Opposite: explicit.

items.question: Trong câu "A feature is one or more logically related system capabilities that provide value to a user and are described by a set of functional requirements.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A feature is one or more logically related system capabilities that provide value to a user and are described by a set of functional requirements.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng, năng lực. "system capabilities" = các khả năng của hệ thống; tính từ: capable (có khả năng).
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): an ability to do. "System capabilities" are what the system is able to do; adjective: capable.

items.question: Trong câu "The hierarchy: one feature decomposes into several user requirements, and each user requirement leads to several functional requirements.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The hierarchy: one feature decomposes into several user requirements, and each user requirement leads to several functional requirements.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): phân rã thành phần nhỏ. "decompose X into Y" = chia X thành các phần Y nhỏ hơn; nghĩa khác trong sinh học là phân huỷ.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to break into parts. "Decompose X into Y" means to split X into smaller parts; in biology it means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "The hierarchy: one feature decomposes into several user requirements, and each user requirement leads to several functional requirements.", từ "hierarchy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The hierarchy: one feature decomposes into several user requirements, and each user requirement leads to several functional requirements.", what does "hierarchy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchy /ˈhaɪə.rɑː.ki/ (danh từ): hệ thống phân cấp. "a hierarchy of requirements" = hệ phân cấp yêu cầu; tính từ: hierarchical.
items.explanationEn: hierarchy /ˈhaɪə.rɑː.ki/ (noun): a ranking in levels. "A hierarchy of requirements" arranges them in levels; adjective: hierarchical.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic example — enhancing a text editor", từ "enhance" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic example — enhancing a text editor", what does "enhance" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enhance /ɪnˈhɑːns/ (động từ): cải tiến, nâng cao. "enhance a product" = cải tiến sản phẩm; danh từ: enhancement (bản nâng cấp, cải tiến).
items.explanationEn: enhance /ɪnˈhɑːns/ (verb): to improve. "Enhance a product" means to improve it; noun: enhancement.

items.question: Trong câu "A customer list of desired product features is not equivalent to a description of the user task-related needs.", từ "equivalent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A customer list of desired product features is not equivalent to a description of the user task-related needs.", what does "equivalent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (tính từ): tương đương. "be equivalent to X" = tương đương với X; cũng là danh từ: "the equivalent of".
items.explanationEn: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (adjective): equal in value. "Be equivalent to X" means equal to X; it is also a noun: "the equivalent of".

items.question: Trong câu "That is why this course keeps insisting: understand user goals first, then derive the features.", từ "insist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is why this course keeps insisting: understand user goals first, then derive the features.", what does "insist" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: insist /ɪnˈsɪst/ (động từ): khăng khăng, nhấn mạnh. "insist on something / insist that…" = nhất quyết, nhấn mạnh rằng…
items.explanationEn: insist /ɪnˈsɪst/ (verb): to firmly demand. "Insist on something / insist that…" means to state it firmly and not give way.

items.question: Trong câu "That is why this course keeps insisting: understand user goals first, then derive the features.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is why this course keeps insisting: understand user goals first, then derive the features.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, rút ra. "derive X from Y" = suy ra X từ Y; trong toán học, "derivative" là đạo hàm.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. "Derive X from Y" means to get X out of Y; in maths a "derivative" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "A service or performance characteristic: performance, security, availability, usability, portability.", từ "characteristic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A service or performance characteristic: performance, security, availability, usability, portability.", what does "characteristic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: characteristic /ˌkær.ək.təˈrɪs.tɪk/ (danh từ): đặc điểm, đặc tính. "performance characteristics" = các đặc tính hiệu năng. Đừng nhầm với "character" (nhân vật).
items.explanationEn: characteristic /ˌkær.ək.təˈrɪs.tɪk/ (noun): a typical quality. "Performance characteristics" are qualities of performance. Do not confuse with "character" in a story.

items.question: Trong câu "This distinction is often skipped, and it is what clutters most specifications.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This distinction is often skipped, and it is what clutters most specifications.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân biệt. "make/draw a distinction between A and B" = phân biệt A và B; nghĩa khác: "with distinction" = loại xuất sắc.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a difference. "Draw a distinction between A and B" means to separate them; "with distinction" is a different sense: with honours.

items.question: Trong câu "This distinction is often skipped, and it is what clutters most specifications.", từ "clutter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This distinction is often skipped, and it is what clutters most specifications.", what does "clutter" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clutter /ˈklʌt.ər/ (động từ): làm rối, bừa bộn. "clutter a document/screen" = làm tài liệu/màn hình rối rắm; cũng là danh từ: clutter (sự bừa bộn).
items.explanationEn: clutter /ˈklʌt.ər/ (verb): to fill untidily. "Clutter a document/screen" means to fill it with messy, unneeded content; also a noun.

items.question: Trong câu "Project requirements belong in the project management plan, not the SRS.", từ "belong in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Project requirements belong in the project management plan, not the SRS.", what does "belong in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: belong in /bɪˈlɒŋ ɪn/ (cụm từ): nên được đặt ở. "X belongs in Y" = chỗ đúng của X là trong Y; khác "belong to" = thuộc về (sở hữu).
items.explanationEn: belong in /bɪˈlɒŋ ɪn/ (phrase): to have its place in. "X belongs in Y" means Y is the right place for X; "belong to" means to be owned by.

items.question: Trong câu "Sourcing, acquisition, and licensing of third-party components.", từ "acquisition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sourcing, acquisition, and licensing of third-party components.", what does "acquisition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: acquisition /ˌæk.wɪˈzɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): việc mua lại. Động từ: acquire (mua lại, có được); "acquiring customer" = khách hàng đặt mua sản phẩm.
items.explanationEn: acquisition /ˌæk.wɪˈzɪʃ.ən/ (noun): the act of obtaining. Verb: acquire (to obtain); an "acquiring customer" is the one buying the product.

items.question: Trong câu "Legal protection for intellectual property (patents, trademarks, copyrights).", từ "intellectual property" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Legal protection for intellectual property (patents, trademarks, copyrights).", what does "intellectual property" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: intellectual property /ˌɪn.təlˌek.tʃu.əl ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (cụm từ): sở hữu trí tuệ. Viết tắt IP; bao gồm bằng sáng chế, nhãn hiệu, bản quyền.
items.explanationEn: intellectual property /ˌɪn.təlˌek.tʃu.əl ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (phrase): legally protected creations. Often shortened to IP; it covers patents, trademarks and copyrights.

items.question: Trong câu "The first is requirements development, made of four interwoven activities — not four sequential phases", từ "interwoven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first is requirements development, made of four interwoven activities — not four sequential phases", what does "interwoven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: interwoven /ˌɪn.təˈwəʊ.vən/ (tính từ): đan xen chặt chẽ. Từ "interweave" (dệt đan vào nhau); "interwoven activities" = các hoạt động diễn ra đan xen.
items.explanationEn: interwoven /ˌɪn.təˈwəʊ.vən/ (adjective): closely intertwined. From "interweave" (to weave together); "interwoven activities" happen mixed together.

items.question: Trong câu "The first is requirements development, made of four interwoven activities — not four sequential phases", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first is requirements development, made of four interwoven activities — not four sequential phases", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự. "sequential phases" = các giai đoạn nối tiếp nhau; trạng từ: sequentially; trái nghĩa: iterative/parallel.
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): following one after another. "Sequential phases" follow one after another; adverb: sequentially; contrast: iterative or parallel.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysis — reaching a richer, more precise understanding and representing requirements in several ways", từ "precise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysis — reaching a richer, more precise understanding and representing requirements in several ways", what does "precise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): chính xác. "a precise definition" = định nghĩa chính xác; trạng từ: precisely; danh từ: precision.
items.explanationEn: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (adjective): exact. "A precise definition" is exact; adverb: precisely; noun: precision.

items.question: Trong câu "Allocating requirements to components in the architecture.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Allocating requirements to components in the architecture.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ, gán cho. "allocate X to Y" = phân bổ X cho Y; cũng dùng cho bộ nhớ: allocate memory (cấp phát bộ nhớ).
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to assign to. "Allocate X to Y" means to assign X to Y; also used for memory: allocate memory.

items.question: Trong câu "Negotiating priorities; finding gaps and unnecessary requirements.", từ "negotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Negotiating priorities; finding gaps and unnecessary requirements.", what does "negotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (động từ): thương lượng. "negotiate priorities/a contract" = thương lượng thứ tự ưu tiên/hợp đồng; danh từ: negotiation.
items.explanationEn: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (verb): to discuss and agree. "Negotiate priorities/a contract" means to discuss until both sides agree; noun: negotiation.

items.question: Trong câu "The practical goal of requirements development is to accumulate a shared understanding good enough to build the next portion of the product at an acceptable level of risk.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The practical goal of requirements development is to accumulate a shared understanding good enough to build the next portion of the product at an acceptable level of risk.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tích luỹ dần. "accumulate knowledge/data" = tích luỹ kiến thức/dữ liệu theo thời gian; danh từ: accumulation.
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (verb): to gather over time. "Accumulate knowledge/data" means to build it up over time; noun: accumulation.

items.question: Trong câu "Defining the requirements baseline: a snapshot of an agreed, reviewed, approved set of requirements, usually for one release or development iteration.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Defining the requirements baseline: a snapshot of an agreed, reviewed, approved set of requirements, usually for one release or development iteration.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (danh từ): bản chụp trạng thái. "a snapshot of X" = hình ảnh/bản ghi trạng thái của X tại một thời điểm; cũng dùng cho sao lưu dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (noun): a point-in-time copy. "A snapshot of X" captures its state at one moment; the word is also used for data backups.

items.question: Trong câu "Evaluating the impact of proposed changes and incorporating approved ones in a controlled way.", từ "incorporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evaluating the impact of proposed changes and incorporating approved ones in a controlled way.", what does "incorporate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to include as part of a whole
items.explanation: incorporate /ɪnˈkɔː.pər.eɪt/ (động từ): đưa vào, kết hợp vào. "incorporate X into Y" = đưa X vào Y; nghĩa khác: thành lập công ty (incorporated = Inc.).
items.explanationEn: incorporate /ɪnˈkɔː.pər.eɪt/ (verb): to include as part of a whole. "Incorporate X into Y" means to include X in Y; another sense is to form a company (Inc.).

items.question: Trong câu "Keeping project plans current with the requirements as they evolve.", từ "evolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keeping project plans current with the requirements as they evolve.", what does "evolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evolve /iˈvɒlv/ (động từ): thay đổi dần. "requirements evolve" = yêu cầu thay đổi dần theo thời gian; danh từ: evolution.
items.explanationEn: evolve /iˈvɒlv/ (verb): to change gradually. "Requirements evolve" means they change gradually; noun: evolution.

items.question: Trong câu "Renegotiating commitments based on the estimated impact of changes.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Renegotiating commitments based on the estimated impact of changes.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): cam kết. "make a commitment" = đưa ra cam kết; động từ: commit (cam kết; trong Git là ghi nhận thay đổi).
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): a promise. "Make a commitment" means to promise; verb: commit (which in Git also means to record changes).

items.question: Trong câu "The object of requirements management is not to stifle change or make it difficult.", từ "stifle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The object of requirements management is not to stifle change or make it difficult.", what does "stifle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stifle /ˈstaɪ.fəl/ (động từ): kìm hãm. "stifle innovation/creativity" = kìm hãm đổi mới/sáng tạo.
items.explanationEn: stifle /ˈstaɪ.fəl/ (verb): to suppress. "Stifle innovation/creativity" means to prevent it from developing.

items.question: Trong câu "It is to anticipate and accommodate the very real changes you can always expect, so as to minimise their disruptive impact on the project.", từ "anticipate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is to anticipate and accommodate the very real changes you can always expect, so as to minimise their disruptive impact on the project.", what does "anticipate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: anticipate /ænˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (động từ): lường trước. "anticipate problems/changes" = lường trước vấn đề/thay đổi để chuẩn bị.
items.explanationEn: anticipate /ænˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (verb): to foresee. "Anticipate problems/changes" means to foresee them and get ready.

items.question: Trong câu "It is to anticipate and accommodate the very real changes you can always expect, so as to minimise their disruptive impact on the project.", từ "accommodate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is to anticipate and accommodate the very real changes you can always expect, so as to minimise their disruptive impact on the project.", what does "accommodate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accommodate /əˈkɒm.ə.deɪt/ (động từ): đáp ứng. "accommodate changes/needs" = điều chỉnh để đáp ứng thay đổi/nhu cầu; nghĩa khác: cung cấp chỗ ở.
items.explanationEn: accommodate /əˈkɒm.ə.deɪt/ (verb): to adapt to fit in. "Accommodate changes/needs" means to make room for them; another sense is to provide a place to stay.

items.question: Trong câu "It is to anticipate and accommodate the very real changes you can always expect, so as to minimise their disruptive impact on the project.", từ "disruptive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is to anticipate and accommodate the very real changes you can always expect, so as to minimise their disruptive impact on the project.", what does "disruptive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disruptive /dɪsˈrʌp.tɪv/ (tính từ): gây xáo trộn. "disruptive impact" = tác động gây xáo trộn; "disruptive technology" = công nghệ đột phá làm thay đổi thị trường.
items.explanationEn: disruptive /dɪsˈrʌp.tɪv/ (adjective): causing disorder. "Disruptive impact" causes disorder; "disruptive technology" is one that shakes up a market.

items.question: Trong câu "Customers often do not understand why eliciting requirements is worth the effort; developers sometimes assume they already know what users need.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customers often do not understand why eliciting requirements is worth the effort; developers sometimes assume they already know what users need.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập. "elicit requirements/information" = khơi gợi, thu thập yêu cầu/thông tin; danh từ: elicitation. Đừng nhầm với "illicit" (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out. "Elicit requirements/information" means to draw it out from people; noun: elicitation. Do not confuse with "illicit" (illegal).

items.question: Trong câu "The result is late-breaking requirements that generate rework and delay completion.", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result is late-breaking requirements that generate rework and delay completion.", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriː.wɜːk/ (danh từ): việc làm lại. "generate/reduce rework" = gây ra/giảm việc làm lại; là nguồn lãng phí lớn trong dự án.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriː.wɜːk/ (noun): work redone to fix it. "Generate/reduce rework" refers to work that must be done again; a major source of waste.

items.question: Trong câu "Worse: the BA specifies apparently perfect requirements, developers implement them correctly, and then nobody uses the solution because the business problem was misunderstood.", từ "apparently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Worse: the BA specifies apparently perfect requirements, developers implement them correctly, and then nobody uses the solution because the business problem was misunderstood.", what does "apparently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: apparently /əˈpær.ənt.li/ (trạng từ): có vẻ như, bề ngoài. "apparently perfect" = có vẻ hoàn hảo (nhưng thực ra không); ngụ ý bề ngoài khác thực tế.
items.explanationEn: apparently /əˈpær.ənt.li/ (adverb): seemingly, on the surface. "Apparently perfect" means it seems perfect but may not be; it hints appearance differs from reality.

items.question: Trong câu "Top contributors to poor estimation: frequent requirements changes, missing requirements, insufficient communication with users, poor specification, and insufficient requirements analysis.", từ "contributor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Top contributors to poor estimation: frequent requirements changes, missing requirements, insufficient communication with users, poor specification, and insufficient requirements analysis.", what does "contributor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contributor /kənˈtrɪb.jə.tər/ (danh từ): nguyên nhân góp phần. "a major contributor to X" = nguyên nhân chính góp phần gây ra X; cũng chỉ người đóng góp (vd. dự án mã nguồn mở).
items.explanationEn: contributor /kənˈtrɪb.jə.tər/ (noun): a contributing factor. "A major contributor to X" is a key cause of X; it can also mean a person who contributes, e.g. to open source.

items.question: Trong câu "Reduced scope creep and reduced project chaos.", từ "scope creep" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reduced scope creep and reduced project chaos.", what does "scope creep" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: scope creep /ˈskəʊp ˌkriːp/ (cụm từ): phạm vi phình to dần. "scope creep" = phạm vi dự án cứ lớn dần mà không kiểm soát; "creep" = bò, nhích dần.
items.explanationEn: scope creep /ˈskəʊp ˌkriːp/ (phrase): gradual uncontrolled growth of scope. "Scope creep" is the slow, uncontrolled expansion of a project; "creep" means to move slowly.

items.question: Trong câu "Two symptoms: one reader can interpret a statement several ways; or multiple readers arrive at different understandings that each make sense to them — the more dangerous case, because a solo review will never surface it.", từ "symptom" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two symptoms: one reader can interpret a statement several ways; or multiple readers arrive at different understandings that each make sense to them — the more dangerous case, because a solo review will never surface it.", what does "symptom" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: symptom /ˈsɪmp.təm/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu. "a symptom of X" = dấu hiệu cho thấy X; gốc y học (triệu chứng bệnh) nhưng dùng rộng cho mọi vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: symptom /ˈsɪmp.təm/ (noun): a warning sign. "A symptom of X" is a sign of X; it comes from medicine but is used for any problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Two symptoms: one reader can interpret a statement several ways; or multiple readers arrive at different understandings that each make sense to them — the more dangerous case, because a solo review will never surface it.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two symptoms: one reader can interpret a statement several ways; or multiple readers arrive at different understandings that each make sense to them — the more dangerous case, because a solo review will never surface it.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cover a road or floor
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "surface an issue/risk" = làm lộ ra vấn đề/rủi ro; khi là danh từ, "surface" nghĩa là bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to bring into view. "Surface an issue/risk" means to make it visible; as a noun, "surface" means the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "The cure: have people representing different perspectives inspect the requirements, write tests against them, and build prototypes.", từ "perspective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cure: have people representing different perspectives inspect the requirements, write tests against them, and build prototypes.", what does "perspective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: perspective /pəˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): góc nhìn, quan điểm. "from a user's perspective" = từ góc nhìn của người dùng; trong hội hoạ, perspective là luật phối cảnh.
items.explanationEn: perspective /pəˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a point of view. "From a user's perspective" means from their point of view; in art it means the depth effect.

items.question: Trong câu "The cure: trace every bit of functionality back to its origin and business justification.", từ "justification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cure: trace every bit of functionality back to its origin and business justification.", what does "justification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: justification /ˌdʒʌs.tɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): lý do biện minh. "business justification" = lý do kinh doanh chính đáng; trong soạn thảo, justification còn là căn đều hai lề.
items.explanationEn: justification /ˌdʒʌs.tɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a good reason for something. "Business justification" is the business reason that makes it worthwhile; in typesetting it means aligning text.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not forget maintenance and field support staff, the people who will convert data from a legacy system, and regulators — parties who may not even know the project exists yet still impose standards on it.", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not forget maintenance and field support staff, the people who will convert data from a legacy system, and regulators — parties who may not even know the project exists yet still impose standards on it.", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ, kế thừa từ trước. "legacy system/code" = hệ thống/mã cũ vẫn đang chạy; danh từ "legacy" là di sản để lại.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. "Legacy system/code" is old but still running; as a noun, a legacy is something handed down.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not forget maintenance and field support staff, the people who will convert data from a legacy system, and regulators — parties who may not even know the project exists yet still impose standards on it.", từ "party" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not forget maintenance and field support staff, the people who will convert data from a legacy system, and regulators — parties who may not even know the project exists yet still impose standards on it.", what does "party" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: party /ˈpɑː.ti/ (danh từ): bên (liên quan). "third party" = bên thứ ba; "the parties involved" = các bên liên quan; nghĩa phổ biến khác là bữa tiệc.
items.explanationEn: party /ˈpɑː.ti/ (noun): a person or group involved. "Third party" and "the parties involved" use this sense; the everyday sense is a social gathering.

items.question: Trong câu "These are the numbers to quote when you need to defend a budget for requirements work", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are the numbers to quote when you need to defend a budget for requirements work", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): bảo vệ bằng lý lẽ. "defend a budget/decision" = bảo vệ ngân sách/quyết định bằng lập luận.
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to argue in support of. "Defend a budget/decision" means to argue that it is right.

items.question: Trong câu "Errors introduced during requirements activities account for 40 to 50 percent of all defects found in a software product.", từ "account for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Errors introduced during requirements activities account for 40 to 50 percent of all defects found in a software product.", what does "account for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chiếm (tỷ lệ). "X accounts for 40%" = X chiếm 40%; "account for" còn nghĩa là giải thích hoặc tính đến.
items.explanationEn: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔːr/ (phrase): to make up a proportion. "X accounts for 40%" means X makes up 40%; "account for" can also mean to explain or to consider.

items.question: Trong câu "Rework — doing again what you thought was already done — consumes 30 to 50 percent of total development cost.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rework — doing again what you thought was already done — consumes 30 to 50 percent of total development cost.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn. "consume time/resources" = tiêu tốn thời gian/tài nguyên; danh từ: consumption.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume time/resources" means to use them up; noun: consumption.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of fixing a defect rises sharply with how late it is found", từ "sharply" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of fixing a defect rises sharply with how late it is found", what does "sharply" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sharply /ˈʃɑːp.li/ (trạng từ): đột ngột và mạnh. "rise/fall sharply" = tăng/giảm mạnh và nhanh; gần nghĩa: steeply.
items.explanationEn: sharply /ˈʃɑːp.li/ (adverb): suddenly and by a lot. "Rise/fall sharply" means to change quickly and by a large amount; similar: steeply.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not balk at the time spent on requirements — balk at the money wasted when a project does not pay enough attention to them.", từ "balk" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not balk at the time spent on requirements — balk at the money wasted when a project does not pay enough attention to them.", what does "balk" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: balk /bɔːk/ (động từ): chùn bước, ngần ngại. "balk at something" = ngần ngại, không muốn chấp nhận điều gì (thường vì giá cao hoặc khó).
items.explanationEn: balk /bɔːk/ (verb): to hesitate at. "Balk at something" means to hesitate or refuse, often because it seems too costly or hard.

items.question: Trong câu "Some people mistakenly believe that time spent discussing requirements simply delays delivery by that same duration — which assumes a zero return on the investment.", từ "mistakenly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some people mistakenly believe that time spent discussing requirements simply delays delivery by that same duration — which assumes a zero return on the investment.", what does "mistakenly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: mistakenly /mɪˈsteɪ.kən.li/ (trạng từ): một cách sai lầm. "mistakenly believe/assume" = tin/giả định một cách sai lầm.
items.explanationEn: mistakenly /mɪˈsteɪ.kən.li/ (adverb): wrongly. "Mistakenly believe/assume" means to believe something that is wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "In reality, investing in good requirements will virtually always return more than it costs.", từ "virtually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality, investing in good requirements will virtually always return more than it costs.", what does "virtually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: virtually /ˈvɜː.tʃu.ə.li/ (trạng từ): hầu như. "virtually always/impossible" = hầu như luôn/không thể; nghĩa khác: trực tuyến, ảo (meet virtually).
items.explanationEn: virtually /ˈvɜː.tʃu.ə.li/ (adverb): almost completely. "Virtually always/impossible" means almost always/impossible; another sense is online (meet virtually).

items.question: Trong câu "No other part so cripples the resulting system if done wrong.", từ "cripple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No other part so cripples the resulting system if done wrong.", what does "cripple" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cripple /ˈkrɪp.əl/ (động từ): làm tê liệt. "cripple a system/economy" = làm hệ thống/nền kinh tế tê liệt.
items.explanationEn: cripple /ˈkrɪp.əl/ (verb): to badly damage. "Cripple a system/economy" means to damage it so badly it can barely work.

items.question: Trong câu "No other part is more difficult to rectify later.", từ "rectify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No other part is more difficult to rectify later.", what does "rectify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rectify /ˈrek.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): khắc phục. "rectify a mistake/problem" = sửa sai/khắc phục vấn đề; trang trọng hơn "fix".
items.explanationEn: rectify /ˈrek.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to correct. "Rectify a mistake/problem" means to put it right; more formal than "fix".

items.question: Trong câu "Ignoring them is a reliable way to ship a fully functional product that users dislike.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ignoring them is a reliable way to ship a fully functional product that users dislike.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành (sản phẩm). "ship a product/feature" = phát hành sản phẩm/tính năng tới người dùng; nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product. "Ship a product/feature" means to release it to users; the original sense is to transport goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements development = elicitation + analysis + specification + validation, performed iteratively, not sequentially.", từ "iteratively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements development = elicitation + analysis + specification + validation, performed iteratively, not sequentially.", what does "iteratively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: iteratively /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): theo vòng lặp. "work iteratively" = làm theo nhiều vòng lặp, mỗi vòng cải tiến thêm; danh từ: iteration.
items.explanationEn: iteratively /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv.li/ (adverb): in repeated cycles. "Work iteratively" means in repeated rounds that each improve the result; noun: iteration.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost to fix a defect rises from 1 to 100 or more when it escapes to operation.", từ "escape" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost to fix a defect rises from 1 to 100 or more when it escapes to operation.", what does "escape" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (động từ): lọt qua kiểm tra. "a defect escapes to production" = lỗi lọt tới môi trường thật; trong lập trình "escape" còn là thoát ký tự.
items.explanationEn: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (verb): to get through undetected. "A defect escapes to production" means it slipped past checks; in code, "escape" can mean to mark a special character.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements are the shared foundation of both software development and project management; this is where the interests of all stakeholders intersect.", từ "intersect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements are the shared foundation of both software development and project management; this is where the interests of all stakeholders intersect.", what does "intersect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: intersect /ˌɪn.təˈsekt/ (động từ): giao nhau, gặp nhau. "where interests intersect" = nơi lợi ích các bên gặp nhau; danh từ: intersection (giao điểm, ngã tư).
items.explanationEn: intersect /ˌɪn.təˈsekt/ (verb): to meet and overlap. "Where interests intersect" is where they overlap; noun: intersection.

items.question: Trong câu "Beyond functionality, actively elicit quality attributes, interfaces, and constraints — users rarely volunteer them.", từ "volunteer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beyond functionality, actively elicit quality attributes, interfaces, and constraints — users rarely volunteer them.", what does "volunteer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work unpaid for a cause
items.explanation: volunteer /ˌvɒl.ənˈtɪər/ (động từ): chủ động nói ra. "volunteer information" = tự nguyện cung cấp thông tin mà không cần hỏi; nghĩa khác: làm tình nguyện.
items.explanationEn: volunteer /ˌvɒl.ənˈtɪər/ (verb): to offer without being asked. "Volunteer information" means to offer it unprompted; another sense is to do unpaid work.
